350452.title: Non-IR conjecture for paths and cycles
350452.depth: primary source bodies read (arXiv:1812.03382v3 definitions, Lemma Lem_Not_Path, Thm on P3-P5/C5-C7, Open Problems; arXiv:2104.09004v2 Open Problems); exhaustive search; independent re-verification; registry screen
350452.summary: A 9-vertex graph G (K_{3,3,3} on parts {0,1,2},{3,4,5},{6,7,8} minus edges 05,08,14,23,26,37,56; 20 edges) has IR(G)=3 and exactly nine IR(G)-sets, whose swap graph is the path P_9. So P_9 is an IR-graph, refuting part (i) and hence the conjunction. Exhaustive: no connected source graph on <=8 vertices has IR-graph P_m (m>=3) or C_m (m>=5); on 9 vertices exactly P_7, P_8, P_9 occur (3 isomorphism classes), no P_6 and no cycle. One-vertex growth gives P_9..P_12 on 10 and P_9..P_14 on 11 vertices (no cycles). Also answers negatively the authors' Problem (independent IR-set => max degree >= 3): {0,1,2} is an independent IR-set.
350452.prior_art: No refutation found: web/literature search (2019-2026), citing works (DM 2022 IR-trees paper still lists it open), survey arXiv:2003.05956, Omega (fresh head e0da8fcc), Lean Pool, OpenAI/math, GitHub (5 queries, 0 hits).
350452.remaining: Lean compilation by root/Sol (draft UNCOMPILED); independent review; cycle part (ii) remains open but is not needed for the negation.

354089.title: Balanced 3-partition conjecture for K_4-free graphs
354089.depth: primary source read (arXiv:2203.15764 Conj. 2.8 = K4bal3par, tripartite proposition, extremal K_{5n/9,2n/9,2n/9}); companion refutation of Conj 2.7 by Xu-Zhang arXiv:2412.13485 (I_7 v C_5 blow-ups) read
354089.summary: Exact for all n divisible by 3. Source proves it for 3-partite graphs. Exact computations: W5 blow-ups I_a v C5^t for n<=24 and (25;4,4,4,4,4) at n=45 (D3b=90 < 100) stay below 4n^2/81; simulated annealing over maximal K4-free graphs n=9 (best 4 = bound, tight), n=12 (best 5); I_a v H with H random maximal triangle-free: n=12 max 6 (< 7.11), n=15 max 10 (< 11.11). No counterexample; asymptotic flag-algebra-type problem.

356083.title: The 106-color obstruction conjecture for partial 6-factorizations
356083.depth: primary source read (arXiv:2209.06402 Thm 1 thm:general, Example 7.12, closing Conjecture)
356083.summary: The conjecture (a non-extendable partial 6-factorization of a sub-hypergraph of K_10^3 with 106 colours exists) is false by the source's own Theorem 1: greedily colour each uncoloured triple (each vertex has degree <=35 in coloured triples, so at most 5 saturated colours per vertex, <=15 blocked of 111), giving a partial 6-factorization of all of K_10^3, which extends to K_38^3 since 38 >= 2(2*10-1) and (38,3,1,6) is admissible. A two-line bridge from the source: zero credit.

349147.title: Extremal Ky Fan norms of the LI-matrix for trees
349147.depth: primary source read (arXiv:2012.11162v2 conjecture after Thm 5.3)
349147.summary: All trees n<=16 (1301, 3159, 7741, 19320 trees for n=13..16), all k: no violation of either inequality (none for n<12 either). The k=n case of the left inequality is exactly the open Radenkovic-Gutman minimum Laplacian-energy conjecture for trees, so a full proof is out of reach.

348375.title: Infinite-family conjecture for self-similar congruences of the 19-regular partition function
348375.depth: Keith-Zanello source (Conj b19conj) and Barman-Singh-Singh arXiv:2209.01639 read (p=5, 11 proved; p=7 fails)
348375.summary: The congruence for p is equivalent to f|T_p == 0 (mod 2) for f = sum b19(2n) q^(8n+3); given an eta-quotient 2-dissection this follows for a positive proportion of primes from Serre's density theorem: the standard Ono/Radu route (routine) and not formalizable here.
